description: An immersive, premium edtech platform focused on an AI-driven cinematic lesson experience. Uses deep darks, high-contrast typography, and striking neon accents (Volt Yellow) to differentiate from generic purple AI slop.

typography.pairing_rules: Use Cabinet Grotesk for all headings. Use Satoshi for standard body text. Use JetBrains Mono for scores, timers, code blocks, and technical labels. NEVER use Inter for headings.

layouts.lesson_player: Cinematic Full-Screen layout. The background should be pure black (bg-black). The Avatar can be a floating PIP (Picture-in-Picture) window or occupy a 30% left column, while the right 70% displays dynamic slides (Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX equations, Recharts). Use a floating, glassmorphic playback control bar at the bottom center.
layouts.dashboard: High-density Bento Grid layout. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Cards should be flat with 1px border-border, no drop shadows in dark mode.
layouts.landing_page: Asymmetric, heavily spaced layout. Use padding scales like py-24 or py-32. Huge typography, overlapping elements, and dark cinematic hero image with bg-black/40 overlay.

surfaces.glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/10 border border-white/10 shadow-lg (for Dark Mode controls/modals)

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:brightness-110 transition-all rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-semibold
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 transition-all rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-semibold

components.forms: Use Shadcn Form components. Inputs should have bg-transparent, border-border, and focus:ring-primary.
components.charts: Use Recharts wrapped in Shadcn Chart components. Use pure, distinct colors like #E3FF37 and #00E5FF for data lines against the dark background.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px subtle borders (border-white/10 or border-zinc-800) to separate grid items and cards instead of shadows.
visual_enhancers.noise: Apply a subtle noise/grain texture overlay (opacity-5) over the background to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glow: Use a subtle blur behind active elements or primary accents. Example: a glowing drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(227,255,55,0.3)] on the active progress bar.

motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition: transform 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease. NEVER use transition-all. Use spring physics (framer-motion) for modal entrances and avatar speech amplitude indicators.
motion.hover_states: Interactive elements should scale slightly (scale-105) or change text color explicitly. Cards can lift (-translate-y-1) on hover.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for dense dashboard metrics and playback controls. Use lucide-react as fallback.
media.avatar: The AI avatar should simulate speech by animating scale/opacity based on a mock audio amplitude value, or by switching SVG mouth states.

landing_hero.description: 3D rendered AI text on dark digital background - use as the main hero background with a dark overlay.

avatar_placeholder.description: Smiling woman presenting - use as the AI Teacher's profile avatar or fallback video feed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize Dark Mode. Implement the CSS variables in index.css as specified in the colors section.
Do not use default Shadcn Vercel look. Customize border radii to be rounded-xl or completely sharp, based on component.
For the Lesson Player, construct a cinematic layout: hiding standard navigation. The controls should float at the bottom using the glass surface classes.
In the Dashboard, use the Bento Grid approach. Avoid using too many distinct colors; let the data and the Volt Yellow primary color stand out.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='play-lesson-button').
Use framer-motion to animate the AI avatar's speaking state and the mid-lesson checkpoint modal popups.
When rendering equations, use KaTeX. When rendering diagrams, use Mermaid.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
